core_gameplay_loop: Guide Fred through Moonpetal Marsh, leap between lilies, dive and surface, catch bugs, evade predators, complete changing level objectives, earn coins, and unlock reusable frog appearances.

updates.product_decision: Owner September 12 2026: Fred Build 11 must not contact the website during startup or enforce website minimum versions; Golden Egg networking is discovery-triggered only.

local_data: Campaign progress, settings, earned coins, unlocked frog cosmetics, local scores and ordinary gameplay records stored on the device
Golden Egg eligibility, pending discovery evidence and explicit Public, Anonymous or local-only choice stored on the device; local-only finds are never automatically submitted
Game Center identity-verification information and Golden Egg service credentials stored privately; iOS credentials use app-scoped device Keychain storage and may survive app deletion
server_data: Game Center team-scoped and game-scoped identifiers, provider-reported display name, identity proof and pseudonymous service player binding used for authenticated Golden Egg functionality
Opaque discovery verification, app/build version, server-assigned ranks, timestamps, public references and Public or Anonymous choice
Network and request-security information used to protect the optional discovery service; no advertising or behavioral analytics

No company website request is made for normal launch, menu, gameplay, Game Center authentication, native leaderboards or foreground resume. Website identity exchange and discovery requests occur only after a local Golden Egg find and the player's publication or Anonymous choice.
excluded_data: Advertising, cross-app tracking, developer analytics and marketing attribution
Precise location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone and health information
Chat, free-form user content, in-app purchases, subscriptions and paid virtual currency
